cnpg_backup_outage.severity: production incident, discovered and resolved during this phase
cnpg_backup_outage.symptom: every CNPG backup in vuoro-shared failed with 'dial tcp 172.17.0.1:443: i/o timeout' from the instance manager
cnpg_backup_outage.cause: appservice a66c6f42 removed vuoro-shared from the clusterwide allow-egress-kube-apiserver-nodes CCNP. That CCNP was the only policy granting the namespace host/remote-node egress. The namespace-local rules reach the API server solely via toCIDRSet 172.17.0.1/32 and toServices; Cilium performs socket-level ClusterIP translation before egress policy enforcement, so the verdict is taken against the control-plane node identity rather than the service CIDR, and those rules never match.
cnpg_backup_outage.verification: control probe -- two pods on the same node in the same namespace with the same image and ServiceAccount token, differing only in the label selecting which policy covers them. The pod covered by a toEntities rule reached the API server (Server Version v1.36.2); the pod covered only by CIDR rules timed out. Reproduced from k8s-worker-gpu-1 and k8s-worker-2, ruling out a node-local CNI fault.
cnpg_backup_outage.fix: appservice PR #1331 (d42d5e09) -- adds toEntities [host, remote-node] scoped to the CNPG cluster pods rather than re-granting the whole namespace, preserving the intent of a66c6f42; adds the same scoped pair for the bridge-staging Job.
cnpg_backup_outage.confirmed_by: vuoro-work5-pre-bridge-20260804084900 completed -- the first successful backup since 2026-08-02

first_attempt.outcome: failed closed at the backup-checkpoint init gate, before any database connection
first_attempt.error: unable to read certificate-authority /var/run/secrets/bridge-backup-gate/ca.crt: permission denied
first_attempt.cause: projected volume files are owned root:root; the pod runs as 1000:1000, so defaultMode 0440 matched only the 'other' bits. The token itself was readable because kubelet chowns projected serviceAccountToken files to the container's runAsUser; the configMap ca.crt source gets no such treatment.
first_attempt.assessment: the gate behaved as designed; it is not decorative

second_attempt.init_gate: pre-bridge CNPG backup identity and completion verified
